body: Line is 407,944.00, not the 374,654.00 the 29 SVB notices add up to. Leapblock closed out their file on 13 Feb and gave the USD wires they received, by our wire date: 2023 104,868 (starting with 33,290 on 13 Sep 2023); 2024 232,726; 2025 62,950; 2026 7,400. That's 407,944 over 30 wires. Per the angel note their closeout beats the notices. 2024 to 2026 match the notices exactly. The difference is the 13 Sep 2023 wire of 33,290, which went out of SVB (Blake approved it that day) but has no Payment Processed notice. Split by date: DD 337,594 / ZM 59,250 / CF 11,100, all build.

Line is 37,056.00, not the 41,088.00 the 11 notices add up to. The 2 Apr 2024 wire of 4,032.00 to ***8605 came back: Blake had the wrong account number and re-sent it to ***3341 (Leonard, #founders, 12 Feb). It counts at zero. The 10 notices to ***3341 are all build: DD 28,128 / ZM 8,928.

Line is 0.00, not 125.00. The 7 May 2024 wire came back the same day (Leonard's note above). The resend went through Payoneer, so it goes in only if a receipt reached my mail. All I have are Dixelar's Payoneer payment requests (125 USD on 5 May 2024 and on 25 Sep 2024), not a payment receipt, so nothing is counted. Bucket is marketing (ad videos) if a receipt turns up.

Line is 0.00, not 4,000.00. Blake confirmed by email (Chase records, 13 Feb) that ***3203 is our own Chase account. He moved the money over after Carta's renewal came out of Chase, so it never left the company. Money moved between our own accounts isn't spending: no bucket, and the line stays at zero.
The notice is BGN 1,999.00, not dollars. It stays in BGN next to the line (Company, equipment: the laptop) and isn't added to any dollar total.
